name: PlasmaCube
summary: A unique French Cobblemon server offering a fresh and exclusive Pokemon experience.
description: # Vis l'aventure Pokémon comme jamais tu ne l'as vécue : Prépare-toi à vivre la meilleure expérience Cobblemon sur PlasmaCube, le premier serveur où tu commences ton aventure avec un starter Shiny. Que tu sois un chasseur de shiny ou un tout nouveau dresseur, notre communauté française est là pour t'accueillir et te faire vivre des sessions inoubliables. ## Ce qui nous rend unique : - Starter Shiny offert dès la première connexion - Cartes à collectionner avec des effets uniques en jeu - Éclosion d'œufs shiny avec des animations spectaculaires - Multi-Pokédex - Tour de Combat pour affronter les meilleurs dresseurs - Mode Ranked avec son économie intégrée - Daily rewards - Événements réguliers ( Booster shiny, tournois .. ) - Méga-Gemmes & Évolutions Z-A - Monde Safari Tout se débloque en jouant grades, battlepass, cosmétiques, cartes. Rejoins PlasmaCube maintenant et écris ta propre légende dans l'aventure Pokémon la plus complète de France !

name: Complex Cobblemon
summary: One of the largest and most popular Cobblemon servers. Java 1.21.1, IP modrinth.mc-complex.com. All 18 gyms, free legendary spawns, every Mega Evolution, world boss raids, Dungeons, clans and Ranked PvP.
description:
# Complex Cobblemon
Complex Cobblemon is one of the largest and most popular Cobblemon servers, a Pokemon Minecraft server with 800+ players online at peak, running on Minecraft Java 1.21.1 as part of the Complex Gaming network (online since 2016). Catch, train and battle your way through all 18 gyms, hunt free legendary spawns, fight world boss raids every hour, and team up with friends in parties, clans and Dungeons.
 
**Cobblemon Server IP:** modrinth.mc-complex.com
**Version:** Minecraft Java 1.21.1 with the official Complex Cobblemon modpack (Java only, not Bedrock)
 
## Complex in numbers
- 800+ players online at peak on Complex Cobblemon
- 2,000+ players online at once across the Complex network every day, with peaks near 2,800
- 235,000+ members in our Cobblemon and Pixelmon Discord
- 2.7 million+ Cobblemon and Pixelmon modpack downloads on CurseForge
- Running Minecraft servers since 2016
 
## Your adventure
- Your rival meets you at spawn to help you choose your starter, then explore the world with /rtp
- The full Cobblemon Pokedex, every legendary, and many custom Pokemon and skins
- Every Mega Evolution from the Pokemon games, plus Terastallization
- Ride your Pokemon across the world
- Boosted shiny rate of 1 in 4,096, plus shiny boosters from gyms, the Battle Tower, Dungeons and crates
- Play with friends using /party and /friend
 
## Gyms, battles and competition
- All 18 gyms in order, then the Battle Tower and the Battle Cafe, with the Elite Four coming soon
- Ranked battles and tournaments every 4 hours
- Build a competitive team with the PokeBuilder and fine-tune IVs, EVs, natures and movesets
- Guides: [Cobblemon Gyms in Order](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/67/cobblemon-gyms-in-order-all-18-gyms-types-and-levels-2026/), [Battle Tower](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/68/cobblemon-battle-tower-guide-floors-coins-and-rewards-2026/), [Battle Cafe](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/79/cobblemon-battle-cafe-guide-every-cafe-boss-and-reward-2026/), [Ranked PvP](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/77/cobblemon-ranked-pvp-guide-ranked-battles-ratings-and-rewards-2026/)
 
## Legendaries
- Legendary Pokemon spawn naturally for every player, completely free, including mythicals, Ultra Beasts and Paradox Pokemon
- Boost your odds with /legend through free in-game tasks
- See recent legendary and rare spawns with /ll
- Full guide: [Cobblemon Legendaries: How to Get and Spawn Them](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/63/cobblemon-legendaries-how-to-get-and-spawn-them-2026/)
 
## Raids and Dungeons
- Custom world boss raids every 45 to 60 minutes, plus dungeon raids
- Dungeons graded from D to S, with Dungeon Coins and exclusive rewards for your best runs
- Guide: [Cobblemon World Bosses](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/76/cobblemon-world-bosses-raid-times-tiers-and-rewards-2026/)
 
## Economy
- Earn coins from jobs, contracts, hunts, bingo, gyms, the Battle Tower and Ranked
- Earn gems, a rare premium currency you can spend on the GTS and auction house or convert into store gift cards
- Set up chest shops and player warps to run your own shop
- Guide: [Hunts, Contracts and Bingo](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/78/cobblemon-hunts-contracts-and-bingo-daily-rewards-guide-2026/)
 
## Clans
- Create or join a clan, climb the clan ranks and compete for gems on /clan top
- Daily clan missions, weekly clan hunts, clan games, clan wars and clan gyms
- Upgrade your clan with more members, warps, vault space, a clan bank and base perks
 
## Claims and ranks
- Get a Claiming Wand and 3 free claim chunks on your first join, then earn more claims as you play
- Earn free Dex Ranks, from Trainer to PokeMaster, by completing your Pokedex
 
## Cobbleverse server: Cobbleverse players welcome
Yes, Complex Cobblemon fully supports the official COBBLEVERSE modpack. Join straight from the COBBLEVERSE modpack, where Complex is the #1 featured server, and play on the same server, with the same economy and community, as players on our official modpack.
- Guides: [Cobbleverse Servers: Where to Play Cobbleverse Multiplayer](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/61/cobbleverse-servers-where-to-play-cobbleverse-multiplayer-2026/), [How to Play Cobbleverse With Friends](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/65/how-to-play-cobbleverse-with-friends-multiplayer-guide-2026/)
 
## How to join the Cobblemon server
1. Install the Complex Cobblemon modpack from CurseForge or Modrinth and give it 3 to 5 GB of RAM (4 GB is best).
2. Launch the pack, open Multiplayer and join **modrinth.mc-complex.com**.
3. Your rival meets you at spawn to help you pick your starter.
 
Step-by-step help: [How to Download and Install Cobblemon](https://www.mc-complex.com/forums/pixelmon/wiki-page/70/how-to-download-and-install-cobblemon-on-pc-and-mac-2026/)
